22 invoices had a due date before 30 April 2025, making them overdue as of that date. (This is based on due date vs. the 30 April 2025 cutoff; the underlying data is a snapshot as of 2025-06-30, and there is no separate payment date in the model, so "overdue" here means the due date had passed.) They span all four source systems — SAP, Oracle, Baan, and Workday.
